summary.text: April Dobson is a state representative from Oregon House District 39 who has served since January 13, 2025, and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot, where Ballotpedia lists her with Republican, Democratic and Independent Party of Oregon nominations.

paragraphs.text: April Dobson earned a high school diploma from Scappoose High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Oregon, and her career experience includes working as a nonprofit professional.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mother of three and an elected member of the North Clackamas School Board.
